summary_en: ¥80/share annual dividend (¥77 prior): interim ¥40/share (+¥3), final ¥40/share. FY3/27 ended March 2027. DOE floor 2.5% maintained. Upside revision reflects stronger net profit guidance and higher projected shareholders' equity.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Earnings and Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief: On 10 August 2026, ENOMOTO Co., Ltd. revised upward its fiscal 2027 (year ending 31 March 2027) earnings and dividend forecasts. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders is now expected to reach ¥175.0 billion (+25.0% vs. prior forecast of ¥140.0 billion), driven by strong sales momentum in power semiconductor lead frames (automotive), optical connectors for smartphones, and process improvements. The company raised its interim (Q2) dividend from ¥37/share to ¥40/share (+¥3), maintaining the final dividend at ¥40/share, for a total annual dividend of ¥80/share (up from ¥77/share). The increase reflects stronger-than-projected shareholders' equity at 31 March 2027 relative to the mid-term plan "Vision 2030 2nd STEP" (ending March 2027). The company targets ¥30 billion sales, ¥2.4 billion operating profit, and 9% ROE by the plan's conclusion. A dividend-on-equity (DOE) floor of 2.5% remains in place.
